dsDescriptionValue.value: The Environmental Geography Group developed a set of public good and biodiversity maps.These are summarised and documented in a consistent database. This dataset contains maps of the public goods climate regulation, pollination, erosion prevention, flood regulation, heritage, recreation, and wild food provisioning, and the biodiversity indicators megafauna habitat, farmland bird species richness, and agrobiodiversity. Full explanation is included in the data package.
